description: 3 exemplars + 2 near-misses + 1 counterexample. Authored 2026-10-09 when the settings-key retirement touched this skill. Exemplars are coding against a structure that must be read first (schema, API shape, vendor package), including the German form. Near-misses share the vocabulary but write SQL against a known schema or design a new API rather than discover an existing one.

call the payments provider's GraphQL API to fetch refunds; I'm not sure what fields it returns
bevor du das DTO baust: lies erst nach, welche Felder die API wirklich liefert
write an efficient SQL query that joins these two tables I pasted
